mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, source, status, reviewer_id, reviewed_at FROM t_health_report WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_health_report (user_id, title, content, source, status, reviewer_id, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{source}, #{status}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_health_report SET user_id=#{userId}, title=#{title}, content=#{content}, source=#{source}, status=#{status}, reviewer_id=#{reviewerId}, reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
